prompt.system_instruction: Revise ONLY the supplied Governing Instruction Provenance section. The user calls the governing-instruction section and its provenance capture the same responsibility. Use their existing contents and definitions as the specification. Produce the actual complete revised section, not another specification or a full-document rewrite.
prompt.heuristic: Consolidate the supplied authority location information and capture questions into one Governing Instruction Provenance procedure. Identify and fully read the applicable current governing instruction, capture and verify actual current backing file ID and persistent Library ID from live retrieval metadata, and handle unavailable metadata truthfully. Preserve relevant applicability information without duplicating the removed metadata section. Define necessary inputs locally once, ask capture questions using ${name.definition}, return captured values using ${name}, and include useful normal and failure/mirror examples. Use plain-language instruction titles and the existing input/question/example structure. Do not introduce a redundant provenance wrapper or unneeded fields. Do not invent current identifiers or live execution; this pass revises the instruction, not performs host Library retrieval.

output_schema.revised_section: Complete revised Governing Instruction Provenance procedure, including local input definitions, operational capture questions with returns, and purposeful examples.
output_schema.revision_notes: Explain consolidation and any necessary changes from the supplied section.

prompt.template_suffix: Return the actual complete revised section only with its revision notes. Do not revise metadata or any other section. The latest trigger overrides earlier broad or metadata-only tasks.
